source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 借剑一观，剑断情伤
title: 借剑一观，剑断情伤
purpose: 承接无锋来历段落：白衣女子请拓拔野借断剑一观；拓拔野恭敬递剑；断剑受无形牵引飞入女子手中；锈迹落下，剑身泛起青白光；女子睹剑伤情落泪。画面只做无声视觉，不生成口播或字幕。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 uses previous Wufeng storyboard or Tuobaye turnaround for the respectful sword handover. SH02 uses adult Yushiqie reference to stabilize the white-clothed woman. SH03 uses previous Wufeng storyboard to keep the broken sword prop. SH04 uses adult Yushiqie reference or previous resolve storyboard for the tear reaction.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, speech bubbles, musical notes, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.inscription_rule: If the sword needs old name marks, render only abstract gold/white engraved strokes that are not readable as Chinese characters.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, lip-sync, flute/xiao audio, heartbeat audio, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 不知公子可否将此剑借我一观么？
这柄剑原是我族七大神器之一。
